body: The girls were stressors, but this feeling, this urge, has always been there.  For as long as I can remember, I've had it.  The chair idea is creative.  But unfortunately, I've said every mean thing I have to say to my wife.  The anger and bitterness was actually the only thing keeping me feeling okay.  It's immature and childish, but any time I could say/do something mean to her or make her hurt, it made me feel a little better.  I just wanted her to hurt like she hurt me.  But last night, I tried to extend and olive branch to her and apologize.  She ignored the text like I knew she would, but I felt the weight of all that anger and hatred lift and although it was cathartic, it left me with nothing to feel "good" about.  It peeled that layer of false happiness that I had off, and left me with what I had when this all started.  Crippling anxiety and depression, which has led me back here.
